SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Ast
The Mandela abstract syntax tree.
Ast.Arm
One match arm.
Ast.Binary
An infix operator.
Ast.BlockValue
A block used as an expression value (the tail value of a fun f() = { ... } body or a lambda).
Ast.Call
A call, callee(args).
Ast.Coerce
A runtime conversion, x as Int.
Ast.Conditional
A conditional expression written with if/else in expression position, as in if (ready) "go" else "wait".
Ast.Contains
A membership test, value in container (and its not in form).
Ast.Expr
An expression: something that produces a value.
Ast.Function
A function or lambda value.
Ast.Index
An indexing expression, target[index].
Ast.Interpolated
An interpolated string: alternating literal text and embedded expressions, evaluated left to right and concatenated with each value's display form.
Ast.ListLit
A list literal, [a, b, c].
Ast.Literal
A literal of any primitive kind.
Ast.Literal.LitKind
Which payload a Ast.Literal carries.
Ast.MapLit
A map literal, { "k": v, name: v }.
Ast.Match
A match expression: the first matching arm's body is the value.
Ast.Member
A property access, target.name.
Ast.MethodCall
A method call, target.name(args).
Ast.Name
A bare name: a local, an upvalue, a global, a function, a class.
Ast.Node
Anything in the tree that occupies a source position.
Ast.Param
One declared parameter or value-type field.
Ast.Pattern
A match arm pattern or a destructuring let target.
Ast.Pattern.Any
_: matches anything and binds nothing.
Ast.Pattern.Destructure
Matches a list, a map or an instance and binds its parts.
Ast.Pattern.LiteralOf
Matches a value equal to a literal.
Ast.Pattern.Named
Binds the whole value to a name.
Ast.Pattern.TypeOf
Matches a type, optionally binding the value.
Ast.RangeLit
A range, a..b (inclusive) or a..<b (exclusive).
Ast.SafeMember
A null-safe property access, target?.name.
Ast.SafeMethodCall
A null-safe method call, target?.name(args).
Ast.Stmt
A statement: something that is executed for its effect.
Ast.Stmt.Assign
An assignment to an existing binding, a field or an element.
Ast.Stmt.Block
A brace-delimited sequence of statements; every block introduces its own scope.
Ast.Stmt.Break
break inside the nearest enclosing loop.
Ast.Stmt.ClassDecl
A class declaration with a primary constructor, mutable state, methods and optional inheritance.
Ast.Stmt.CompoundAssign
A compound assignment, target op= value.
Ast.Stmt.Continue
continue inside the nearest enclosing loop.
Ast.Stmt.Defer
defer stmt: run after the enclosing function body finishes.
Ast.Stmt.EnumDecl
An enum declaration: a fixed set of named, equatable values.
Ast.Stmt.Expression
An expression evaluated for its side effects; its value is dropped.
Ast.Stmt.ExprValue
A declaration whose value is kept as the statement's result inside a function body (used by the implicit-return rule).
Ast.Stmt.For
for (pattern in iterable) body, over a list, map, range, string or any value that supports iterate.
Ast.Stmt.Fun
A function declaration.
Ast.Stmt.If
if / else if / else.
Ast.Stmt.Import
import "path": load another Mandela source as a module and bind its exported names under the module alias.
Ast.Stmt.Let
A let (immutable) or var (mutable) binding.
Ast.Stmt.Loop
loop { ... } with break / continue.
Ast.Stmt.Return
return with an optional value.
Ast.Stmt.Throw
throw expr.
Ast.Stmt.Try
try / catch / finally.
Ast.Stmt.TypeDecl
A type declaration: an immutable, equatable record with named fields, optional defaults and optional methods.
Ast.Stmt.Use
use std.json: bring a standard-library module into scope.
Ast.Stmt.While
while (cond) body.
Ast.SuperMethod
A super-dispatched method call, super.name(args).
Ast.SuperRef
A reference to the inherited members of the enclosing class.
Ast.Test
An is type test, x is Int.
Ast.ThisRef
A reference to the enclosing instance inside a method.
Ast.Unary
A prefix operator.
Ast.Visitor
A read-only visitor over the tree.
Ast.Walk
Depth-first traversal that visits every node exactly once.
Builtins
The part of a Mandela runtime that the machine knows nothing about.
Callable
Marker for every Mandela value that can be called: a script closure, a bound method, or a function the host contributed.
Capabilities
What a script is allowed to do, decided by the host rather than by the script.
Capabilities.Builder
Assembles a capability set.
Capabilities.Grant
One grantable side effect.
ClassDef
The description of a declared type, carried as one constant-pool entry.
CompiledFunction
One compiled function: the instruction array, the constant pool, and the shape of the frame it needs.
CompiledFunction.Builder
Assembles one function body.
Compiler
The Mandela compiler: a parsed statement list in, one CompiledFunction of bytecode out.
Compiler.Result
A compiled program: the body to run, the names it exports, the findings.
Diagnostic
A structured language problem: what the tool chain found, where, and how urgent it is.
Diagnostic.Severity
How urgent a diagnostic is, most urgent first.
Disassembler
Turns compiled bodies into text: the tool behind mandela dump, the editor's structure view and every bug report about an instruction stream.
EditorServices
The language's editor services: the answers a tool needs about a buffer rather than from a program.
EditorServices.Entry
One declaration in a buffer, as an outline row.
Files
The file gateway std.fs talks through.
Frame
One activation of a Mandela body.
HostFunction
A Java or Kotlin function published into a Mandela global table.
HostFunction.Adaptor
The immutable implementation HostFunction.of(java.lang.String, int, org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.rt.HostFunction.Body) returns.
HostFunction.Body
The lambda shape HostFunction.of(String, int, Body) accepts.
HostValues
The rule that decides what a Java (or Kotlin) object means when a host hands it to a script.
Interop
The bridge between Java (and Kotlin) values and Mandela values.
Json
JSON in and out, with no third-party library.
Keywords
Mandela's reserved words, and the words that only matter in one syntactic position.
LangException
A language error carrying the source position that caused it: an unterminated string from the Lexer, a syntax error from the Parser, or an illegal construct rejected by the compiler.
Lexer
The Mandela scanner: source text in, Token list out.
Machine
The services a script can reach from inside the machine.
Mandela
The one class a host needs to meet, and the single place the language's public identity lives.
MandelaClass
A declared type: the runtime object behind class, type and enum.
MandelaClass.Kind
Which kind of declared type this is.
MandelaCli
The mandela command: run a program, check one, evaluate a one-liner, start a session, look at the instructions.
MandelaClosure
A script function value: a compiled body plus the variables it closed over.
MandelaError
A Mandela error: a value in the script and the throwable that unwinds the machine, in one object.
MandelaInstance
An instance of a declared type.
MandelaIterator
The cursor a for loop drives.
MandelaList
A Mandela list: an ordered, mutable sequence of values, written [1, 2, 3].
MandelaMap
A Mandela map: an insertion-ordered set of string-keyed values, written { "name": "Ada", score: 7 }.
MandelaRange
A Mandela range: a..b includes b, a..<b does not, and a..b step s produces every s-th value.
MandelaScriptEngine
Mandela as a javax.script engine, so a host that already embeds one script engine gets a second without learning a new API.
MandelaScriptEngineFactory
The discovery half of the JSR-223 pair: what a registry reads before anyone has an engine.
Op
The Mandela bytecode: 66 instructions of a two-int-per-slot stack machine.
Operators
The operator meanings: what +, /, [i] and .length do to the values the machine puts in front of them.
Parser
The Mandela parser: a recursive-descent parser that turns source text into a list of statements.
Parser.Program
What a successful parse hands back.
Ref
A mutable cell holding one variable's value.
Runtime
One Mandela engine: the pair a host actually holds, a VM and the StandardLibrary it asks questions of, wired to the host's console and capability set.
Runtime.Builder
The builder Runtime.builder() returns.
StandardLibrary
The vocabulary every Mandela host shares: the methods on the built-in types, the global functions, and the std.* modules.
StandardLibrary.Importer
Loads a file module on the library's behalf.
Token
One immutable lexical token, with the position needed to report a problem back to a human.
Token.InterpPiece
A chunk of an interpolated string: either literal text or an embedded expression.
Token.InterpPiece.Expression
A ${...} expression.
Token.InterpPiece.Text
A run of literal characters.
TokenKind
The lexical classes of the Mandela language.
Values
The value semantics of Mandela in one place: what a value is called, when it is true, how it prints, how it compares, how it converts and how arithmetic behaves on it.
VM
The Mandela virtual machine: a two-word-per-instruction stack interpreter.
VM.Output
A destination for script output: a raw character sink, one call per write.
